title: A Tactical Disaster for Russia’s Military

sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报》的萨布丽娜·塔弗尼西。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这是《每日新闻》节目。

sentences.en: Three months since Russia invaded Ukraine, one of the biggest surprises has been the inability of the Russian military to turn the tide of the war.
sentences.zh: 俄罗斯入侵乌克兰已经三个月了，最大的意外之一就是俄军无力扭转战局。

sentences.en: Today, my colleague Anton Trinovsky on a clash that left hundreds of Russian soldiers dead and how its aftermath is raising doubts inside Russia, even
sentences.zh: 今天，我的同事安东·特里诺夫斯基将讲述一场导致数百名俄罗斯士兵死亡的冲突，以及它在俄罗斯内部引发的质疑，即使是

sentences.en: among the military's most ardent supporters.
sentences.zh: 在军队最坚定的支持者中也是如此。

sentences.en: It's Monday, May 23rd.
sentences.zh: 今天是5月23日，星期一。

sentences.en: So Anton, tell me about this most recent development you've been reporting on.
sentences.zh: 那么安东，跟我说说你一直在报道的这个最新进展吧。

sentences.en: So it's a Russian attempt to cross a river gone terribly wrong.
sentences.zh: 这是一次俄罗斯试图渡河却惨遭失败的行动。

sentences.en: The Russians earlier in May tried to cross the Donets River in eastern Ukraine in an effort to encircle Ukrainian troops that were stationed in that area.
sentences.zh: 5月初，俄军试图跨越乌克兰东部的顿涅茨河，目的是包围驻扎在该地区的乌克兰军队。

sentences.en: This is part of the battle for the
sentences.zh: 这是顿巴斯战役的一部分，

sentences.en: Donbass, that eastern Ukrainian region you've been hearing so much about that the Russians are trying to take control of.
sentences.zh: 就是你经常听到的那个俄罗斯正试图控制的乌克兰东部地区。

sentences.en: So the Russian military sent hundreds of troops, dozens and dozens of tanks and
sentences.zh: 当时俄军派遣了数百名士兵、数十辆坦克和

sentences.en: other armored vehicles to the river to try to get across using these temporary pontoon bridges that the military is trained to set up.
sentences.zh: 其他装甲车辆前往河边，试图利用军队训练时搭建的临时浮桥过河。

sentences.en: The problem was they were doing this in an area that was very much vulnerable to Ukrainian artillery fire.
sentences.zh: 问题在于，他们行动的区域非常容易受到乌克兰炮火的攻击。

sentences.en: And so as these forces showed up at the river and paused to try to set up that temporary crossing, they became sitting ducks bunched up there along the water for the Ukrainian
sentences.zh: 当这些部队出现在河边并停下来试图架设临时渡口时，他们就成了活靶子，挤在水边，成为了乌克兰

sentences.en: attack.
sentences.zh: 攻击的目标。

sentences.en: And what the satellite images show us is that dozens of these Russian military vehicles there were hit, were destroyed by the artillery fire.
sentences.zh: 卫星图像显示，数十辆俄罗斯军车在那里被炮火击中并摧毁。

sentences.en: You can see tanks and other vehicles partially submerged in the river, burnt out and abandoned in the woods.
sentences.zh: 你可以看到坦克和其他车辆部分沉入河中，在树林里被烧毁并遗弃。

sentences.en: This was really one of the most disastrous Russian tactical efforts that we know of in this whole war.
sentences.zh: 这确实是我们在这场战争中已知的最灾难性的俄罗斯战术行动之一。

sentences.en: What Western analysts are saying now is that more than 400 Russian troops were killed or injured in this failed crossing.
sentences.zh: 西方分析人士现在表示，在这次失败的渡河行动中，有超过400名俄罗斯士兵死亡或受伤。

sentences.en: More than 80 military vehicles were loSt. It really shows us the kind of tactical miscues that this
sentences.zh: 超过80辆军车损失。这确实向我们展示了这次

sentences.en: Russian offensive continues to suffer from.
sentences.zh: 俄罗斯攻势中持续存在的战术失误。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: We've seen a lot of this throughout the course of the war.
sentences.zh: 我们在整个战争过程中已经看到了很多这样的情况。

sentences.en: I mean, I'm thinking of the Moskva, the Russian warship that the
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我想到了“莫斯科号”，那艘被

sentences.en: Ukrainians sank in the Black Sea, and that huge Russian convoy coming down toward Kyiv that took such heavy losses.
sentences.zh: 乌克兰人在黑海击沉的俄罗斯军舰，还有那支向基辅推进、损失惨重的庞大俄军车队。

sentences.en: And all of this, you know, from an army that we all thought before the war was just incredibly formidable.
sentences.zh: 所有这些，你知道，都来自一支我们在战前认为极其强大的军队。

sentences.en: What was the explanation for what went so wrong in this case?
sentences.zh: 对于这次行动为何如此失败，有什么解释吗？

sentences.en: So we're now almost three months into the war, and the Russians have still not accomplished one of Putin's seemingly basic objectives here, which is to take control of the Donbas.
sentences.zh: 战争已经进行了快三个月了，俄罗斯仍然没有实现普京在这里看似基本的目标之一，即控制顿巴斯。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And what a lot of Western officials and analysts are saying is that this disastrous river crossing shows how much
sentences.zh: 许多西方官员和分析人士认为，这次灾难性的渡河行动表明俄罗斯军事指挥部

sentences.en: pressure the Russian military command is under to make progress in that effort.
sentences.zh: 在实现这一目标的努力中承受了多大的压力。

sentences.en: You wouldn't do something this risky if you weren't under immense pressure from the top to show progress.
sentences.zh: 如果不是承受着来自高层的巨大压力要求展示进展，你不会做这种冒险的事情。

sentences.en: And it's risky because you're inherently vulnerable when you're crossing a river?
sentences.zh: 而且这很冒险，因为渡河时本身就非常脆弱？

sentences.en: Exactly, exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错，正是如此。

sentences.en: And then maybe even more interestingly, actually, to me watching all this unfold has been the reaction from the Russian supporters of the war,
sentences.zh: 而且对我来说，看着这一切发生，更有趣的其实是俄罗斯战争支持者的反应，

sentences.en: in particular from this stable of military bloggers, these reporters, many call them propagandists,
sentences.zh: 特别是来自这群军事博主，这些记者，许多人称他们为宣传员，

sentences.en: who are embedded with the troops, typically posting videos of Russian heroism and how horrible the Ukrainians are.
sentences.zh: 他们嵌入在部队中，通常发布俄罗斯英雄主义的视频，并渲染乌克兰人有多么可怕。

sentences.en: They very rarely will criticize something that the Russians are doing.
sentences.zh: 他们很少会批评俄罗斯正在做的事情。

sentences.en: But after this river crossing failed so miserably, several of them came out and really started venting
sentences.zh: 但在这次渡河行动惨败后，他们中的几个人站出来，开始真正发泄

sentences.en: their frustration about the many different problems the Russian campaign has faced.
sentences.zh: 他们对俄罗斯战役所面临的许多不同问题的沮丧情绪。

sentences.en: And what did they say about this battle, Anton?
sentences.zh: 安东，他们对这场战斗说了些什么？

sentences.en: So they said that it was a total disaster and also that it shows the incompetence of the Russian forces.
sentences.zh: 他们说这是一场彻底的灾难，也显示了俄军的无能。

sentences.en: So I would say that's the biggest difference in the analysis here, sort of for Westerners looking at this, you see generals being under a lot of pressure.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为这是这里分析中最大的区别，对于西方观察者来说，你看到的是将军们承受着巨大的压力。

sentences.en: These Russians look at this and just see sheer incompetence.
sentences.zh: 而这些俄罗斯人看到这一点，只觉得纯粹是无能。

sentences.en: You know, for example, one of these guys who goes by Starsh Edy on Telegram, the social messaging app,
sentences.zh: 你知道，例如，其中一个在社交通讯应用 Telegram 上以 Starsh Edy 为名的人，

sentences.en: wrote, how much of an idiot do you have to be to do this kind of thing after three months into the war,
sentences.zh: 写道，战争进行了三个月后，得有多蠢才会做这种事，

sentences.en: to drive a big column of armored vehicles and then concentrate it at a point that's vulnerable to artillery fire.
sentences.zh: 开着一大列装甲车队，然后集中在一个容易受到炮火攻击的点上。

sentences.en: And then he goes on to write that actually this isn't idiocy.
sentences.zh: 然后他接着写道，实际上这并不是愚蠢。

sentences.en: This is direct sabotage.
sentences.zh: 这是直接的破坏。

sentences.en: These bloggers you're describing, do they work for the Russian military?
sentences.zh: 你描述的这些博主，他们为俄罗斯军方工作吗？

sentences.en: Not officially, but they are pretty clearly part of that propaganda effort.
sentences.zh: 不是官方的，但他们很明显是宣传工作的一部分。

sentences.en: So, you know, Russian propaganda is what you see on state television, but it's also what you read from these quasi-independent
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道，俄罗斯的宣传是你从国家电视台看到的，但也是你从这些半独立的

sentences.en: bloggers on Telegram where they have hundreds of thousands, in some cases several million followers,
sentences.zh: Telegram 博主那里读到的，他们拥有数十万，在某些情况下甚至有几百万的粉丝，

sentences.en: posting several times a day, vividly describing the battle, but obviously in a very filtered kind of way.
sentences.zh: 每天发布几次，生动地描述战斗，但显然是以一种非常过滤的方式。

sentences.en: They're sort of pro-government Russian influencers in the military sphere.
sentences.zh: 他们算是军事领域亲政府的俄罗斯网红。

sentences.en: That's a, yes, a very good way to put it, very much influencers.
sentences.zh: 这是一个，是的，非常好的说法，确实非常像网红。

sentences.en: And what were other influencers saying?
sentences.zh: 其他网红说了些什么？

sentences.en: Another one who goes by Vladlen Tatarsky wrote that until we get the last name of the military
sentences.zh: 另一个叫弗拉德连·塔塔尔斯基的人写道，除非我们得到那个制造此事的军事

sentences.en: genius who did this and he answers for this publicly, no reforms in the army will actually happen.
sentences.zh: 天才的名字，并让他公开负责，否则军队内部不会真正发生任何改革。

sentences.en: And then a third blogger who actually has more than two million followers on Telegram didn't just write a post about it.
sentences.zh: 然后第三位在 Telegram 上拥有超过两百万粉丝的博主，不仅仅是写了一篇帖子。

sentences.en: He recorded a whole five-minute video about his disgust with this failed river crossing and what it says about the state of the Russian war effort.
sentences.zh: 他录制了一段整整五分钟的视频，表达了他对这次失败的渡河行动的厌恶，以及它所反映出的俄罗斯战争努力的状态。

sentences.en: His name is Yuri Podolaka.
sentences.zh: 他的名字叫尤里·波多利亚卡。

sentences.en: He started his video by saying, You know, I've been silent for a long time, he says.
sentences.zh: 他在视频开头说，你知道，我沉默了很久，他说。

sentences.en: I've been trying to reach out to different people for a long time, but I see that some people can only be reached by going public.
sentences.zh: 我很久以来一直试图联系不同的人，但我发现有些人只有通过公开才能联系到。

sentences.en: And he says that this failed crossing of the Donets river was the last straw for him that caused him to now
sentences.zh: 他说，这次顿涅茨河渡河失败是他忍受的最后一根稻草，导致他现在

sentences.en: want to go public about all these problems that he's seeing in the Russian military.
sentences.zh: 想要公开他在俄罗斯军队中看到的所有这些问题。

sentences.en: He's saying that even as Russian officials say publicly that everything is going according to plan
sentences.zh: 他说，尽管俄罗斯官员公开表示一切都在按计划进行，

sentences.en: in what the Kremlin calls its special military operation in Ukraine, he says that in fact,
sentences.zh: 在克里姆林宫所谓的乌克兰特别军事行动中，他说实际上，

sentences.en: there are lots and lots of problems, that it feels like to him, the leaders of the Russian military are ignoring.
sentences.zh: 存在着很多很多问题，在他看来，俄罗斯军方领导人似乎在无视这些问题。

sentences.en: He says there's a catastrophic lack of drones and night vision equipment on the battlefield that are making Russian soldiers essentially blind to what the Ukrainians are doing.
sentences.zh: 他说战场上灾难性地缺乏无人机和夜视设备，这使得俄罗斯士兵基本上对乌克兰人的行动视而不见。

sentences.en: And with the drones, you know, he says that there's actually been money raised to buy more drones, but that they can't import them from abroad right now.
sentences.zh: 关于无人机，你知道，他说实际上已经筹集了资金来购买更多的无人机，但他们现在无法从国外进口。

sentences.en: So they're stuck with what they have and they don't have drones?
sentences.zh: 所以他们只能用现有的，而且他们没有无人机？

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 绝对是这样。

sentences.en: You know, the Russian military has its own drones, but they've clearly not been good enough
sentences.zh: 你知道，俄罗斯军队有自己的无人机，但它们显然不够好，

sentences.en: and not deployed at scale enough to really make that difference that they should be making on the battlefield.
sentences.zh: 也没有大规模部署到足以真正产生它们应该在战场上产生的那种影响。

sentences.en: So, Anton, this is kind of amazing to me.
sentences.zh: 所以，安东，这对我来说真是太令人惊讶了。

sentences.en: I mean, you know, throughout the war, we've really not seen much of any dissent from the Russian media.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，你知道，在整个战争期间，我们真的没有看到俄罗斯媒体有太多异议。

sentences.en: But this guy, I mean, he's not even really Russian media, right?
sentences.zh: 但这家伙，我的意思是，他甚至算不上真正的俄罗斯媒体，对吧？

sentences.en: He's this military influencer whose job it is to be pro-government in favor of the war.
sentences.zh: 他是这个军事网红，他的工作就是亲政府，支持战争。

sentences.en: I mean, he's supposed to be spreading the party line, right?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，他应该是在传播官方路线，对吧？

sentences.en: So I guess I'm wondering, what does it mean that he's talking this way?
sentences.zh: 所以我很好奇，他这样说话意味着什么？

sentences.en: And is it dangerous for him to be doing that?
sentences.zh: 他这样做危险吗？

sentences.en: Well, it is risky.
sentences.zh: 嗯，这确实有风险。

sentences.en: I mean, it is risky these days in Russia to really say anything critical about the war effort.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，如今在俄罗斯，对战争努力发表任何批评意见确实是有风险的。

sentences.en: At the same time, those three guys that I quoted, they all continue very much to support the war.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，我引用的那三个人，他们仍然非常支持这场战争。

sentences.en: But the fact that you have some of the loudest cheerleaders of the war effort going public with
sentences.zh: 但事实上，你有一些最响亮的战争啦啦队长公开表示

sentences.en: criticism like this and saying that these aren't just individual tactical mistakes, that the command
sentences.zh: 这样的批评，并说这不仅仅是个别的战术错误，而是战争努力本身的指挥

sentences.en: of the war effort itself is somehow rotten or riddled with problems, that certainly is a signal that things are not going well from the Kremlin's perspective.
sentences.zh: 在某种程度上已经腐烂或充满了问题，这无疑是一个信号，表明从克里姆林宫的角度来看，事情进展并不顺利。

sentences.en: And yet another piece of evidence for that is that it's not just online that you're starting to see pro-Kremlin commentators criticizing various aspects of the war effort.
sentences.zh: 而这方面的另一个证据是，不仅仅是在网上，你开始看到亲克里姆林宫的评论员批评战争努力的各个方面。

sentences.en: It's even starting to show up on the Kremlin's most important propaganda outlet, which is state television.
sentences.zh: 它甚至开始出现在克里姆林宫最重要的宣传渠道上，也就是国家电视台。

sentences.en: So tell me about that.
sentences.zh: 跟我说说那个吧。

sentences.en: So Russian state TV has all these political talk shows where they're broadcast in prime time and you
sentences.zh: 俄罗斯国家电视台有所有这些在黄金时段播出的政治脱口秀节目，你

sentences.en: have political analysts, politicians, lawmakers, retired military officers come on and repeat and amplify the Kremlin's very paranoid militaristic worldview.
sentences.zh: 有政治分析家、政客、立法者、退役军官上台重复并放大克里姆林宫非常偏执的军国主义世界观。

sentences.en: And what happened a few days ago is that a retired military officer came on who's known as a pretty conservative military analySt. And he gave a quite stunning indictment
sentences.zh: 几天前发生的事情是，一位被称为相当保守的军事分析家的退役军官上台了。他给出了一个相当惊人的起诉，

sentences.en: of the state of the war effort and where Russia finds itself now on the international stage.
sentences.zh: 针对战争努力的状态以及俄罗斯现在在国际舞台上的处境。

sentences.en: So first he warns the guests of the show and the many people watching at home not to quote drink information tranquilizers.
sentences.zh: 所以首先他警告节目的嘉宾和许多在家观看的人不要“喝信息镇静剂”。

sentences.en: So not to believe everything that makes you feel good about the idea that morale in the Ukrainian
sentences.zh: 所以不要相信所有让你对乌克兰军队士气低落、

sentences.en: military is low, that the Ukrainians are on the verge of collapse, that the Russians will necessarily prevail.
sentences.zh: 乌克兰人处于崩溃边缘、俄罗斯必然会获胜的想法感到舒服的事情。

sentences.en: All of that does not correspond with reality, he says.
sentences.zh: 他说，所有这些都不符合现实。

sentences.en: He talks about low morale hints at the fact that it's the Russian military that has low morale.
sentences.zh: 他谈到了士气低落，暗示事实上是俄罗斯军队士气低落。

sentences.en: That the Ukrainians are the ones who have a million people willing to fight.
sentences.zh: 乌克兰人才是那些有一百万人愿意战斗的人。

sentences.en: That they're fighting for their homeland and that they are getting more and more equipment from the West to carry on this fight.
sentences.zh: 他们是在为家园而战，而且他们正在从西方获得越来越多的装备来继续这场战斗。

sentences.en: So he says, and you can see, you know, as he's saying this, the camera shows the guests around him kind of getting nervous, a little bit uncomfortable about what's going on.
sentences.zh: 所以他说，你可以看到，你知道，当他说这些话时，摄像机显示他周围的嘉宾有点紧张，对正在发生的事情感到有点不舒服。

sentences.en: But he keeps talking and he says, actually, things will quote, get worse for Russia.
sentences.zh: 但他继续说，他说，实际上，情况对俄罗斯来说会“变得更糟”。

sentences.en: He notes that Russia is increasingly isolated on the world stage.
sentences.zh: 他指出俄罗斯在世界舞台上日益孤立。

sentences.en: He says,
sentences.zh: 他说，

sentences.en: quote, we are in total geopolitical isolation.
sentences.zh: “我们处于完全的地缘政治孤立中。”

sentences.en: The whole world is against us, even if we don't want to admit it.
sentences.zh: 全世界都反对我们，即使我们不想承认。

sentences.en: And the host of the show, Olga Skabeva, one of the most prominent pro-Kremlin television presenters in Russia tries to interrupt him.
sentences.zh: 节目的主持人奥尔加·斯卡贝耶娃，俄罗斯最著名的亲克里姆林宫电视主持人之一，试图打断他。

sentences.en: And she says,
sentences.zh: 她说，

sentences.en: What do you mean we're isolated?
sentences.zh: “你说的孤立是什么意思？”

sentences.en: It's just the West that's against us.
sentences.zh: “只有西方反对我们。”

sentences.en: What about China?
sentences.zh: “中国呢？”

sentences.en: What about
sentences.zh: “那

sentences.en: India?
sentences.zh: 印度呢？”

sentences.en: He responds well.
sentences.zh: 他回答说，嗯。

sentences.en: Even China and India's support is not exactly full-throated here.
sentences.zh: 即使是中国和印度的支持在这里也不完全是全心全意的。

sentences.en: Skabeva kind of goes in with the standard Kremlin line that Russia had no choice but to invade.
sentences.zh: 斯卡贝耶娃用标准的克里姆林宫路线说，俄罗斯别无选择，只能入侵。

sentences.en: Whereas Khodarionok, the retired colonel speaking here, says,
sentences.zh: 而在这里发言的退役上校霍达里奥诺克则说，

sentences.en: Russia's military political and military technical resources are limited in this conflict.
sentences.zh: 俄罗斯在这次冲突中的军事政治和军事技术资源是有限的。

sentences.en: So it was a really kind of fairly benign analysis if you look at it from a Western perspective.
sentences.zh: 所以如果你从西方的角度来看，这确实是一个相当温和的分析。

sentences.en: But if you put yourself on the couch of a Russian who gets their news exclusively from state television, this is kind of a shocking thing to hear.
sentences.zh: 但如果你把自己放在一个只从国家电视台获取新闻的俄罗斯人的沙发上，这听起来确实令人震惊。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: I think what's going on here is that the Kremlin throughout, even now almost three months in, is saying the special operation is going according to plan.
sentences.zh: 我认为这里发生的事情是，克里姆林宫在整个过程中，即使现在已经快三个月了，仍然在说特别行动正在按计划进行。

sentences.en: And that has become just with every passing day an ever more ludicrous thing to say, even to the Russian ear.
sentences.zh: 而这已经变得一天比一天荒谬，即使对俄罗斯人的耳朵来说也是如此。

sentences.en: And so I think what you're seeing right now is this very important trend happening in Russia, where even people who are
sentences.zh: 所以我认为你现在看到的是俄罗斯正在发生的这个非常重要的趋势，即使是那些

sentences.en: in favor of the war, who like Putin and trust Putin and buy into this reasoning for why Russia should
sentences.zh: 支持战争、喜欢普京、信任普京并相信俄罗斯应该入侵乌克兰的理由的人，

sentences.en: invade Ukraine, even they are starting to recognize that the Russian war effort is running into some
sentences.zh: 甚至他们也开始认识到俄罗斯的战争努力正遇到一些

sentences.en: really serious probleMs. And this comes as people outside Russia are doing their own kind of second guessing of their understanding of Russia's military.
sentences.zh: 非常严重的问题。而这正值俄罗斯境外的人们也在对自己对俄罗斯军队的理解进行反思。

sentences.en: Because leading up to this war, a lot of Western analysts and journalists, frankly, including myself, we all thought that the Russian military was a lot
sentences.zh: 因为在战争爆发前，很多西方分析家和记者，坦率地说，包括我自己，我们都认为俄罗斯军队要

sentences.en: more powerful, a lot more effective than what we've seen in the last three months.
sentences.zh: 强大得多，比我们在过去三个月里看到的要有效得多。

sentences.en: So the question is, how did everyone get it wrong?
sentences.zh: 所以问题是，大家是怎么搞错的？

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: So Anton, we all thought the Russian military was this mighty fighting machine, but it didn't turn out that way.
sentences.zh: 所以安东，我们都认为俄罗斯军队是这台强大的战斗机器，但结果并非如此。

sentences.en: Why?
sentences.zh: 为什么？

sentences.en: How did it get to where it is?
sentences.zh: 它是怎么变成现在这个样子的？

sentences.en: So to answer that question, we have to go back to 2008, to the war with Georgia.
sentences.zh: 为了回答这个问题，我们必须回到2008年，回到与格鲁吉亚的战争。

sentences.en: Russia invaded Georgia in August of 2008 and fought a five-day war, quickly overwhelmed the much smaller Georgian military.
sentences.zh: 俄罗斯在2008年8月入侵格鲁吉亚，打了一场五天的战争，迅速压倒了规模小得多的格鲁吉亚军队。

sentences.en: But that war really threw a spotlight on some deep problems in a military that had essentially become this decrepit shell of the mighty Soviet Red Army.
sentences.zh: 但那场战争确实让人们关注到了一支军队中存在的一些深层问题，这支军队本质上已经变成了强大的苏联红军的一具破败外壳。

sentences.en: There were problems in communications so bad that officers were using their personal cell phones rather than the army communications equipment.
sentences.zh: 当时的通讯问题非常严重，军官们甚至不得不使用个人手机，而不是军队的通讯设备。

sentences.en: There was failure in radio contact between ground troops and the Air Force, leading to some really serious friendly fire attacks.
sentences.zh: 地面部队与空军之间的无线电联络中断，导致了一些非常严重的误伤事件。

sentences.en: Tanks and armored personnel carriers were breaking down.
sentences.zh: 坦克和装甲运兵车不断抛锚。

sentences.en: In fact, around that time, army vehicles were so decrepit that repair crews were stationed roughly every 15 miles along their route.
sentences.zh: 事实上，在那段时间里，军队车辆破旧不堪，维修人员不得不沿着行军路线每隔约15英里就驻扎一队。

sentences.en: Oh my God.
sentences.zh: 天哪。

sentences.en: And there were so many morale problems in the military.
sentences.zh: 而且军队中存在着严重的士气问题。

sentences.en: Living conditions were really bad in many cases.
sentences.zh: 在许多情况下，生活条件非常恶劣。

sentences.en: So that was supposed to be a real turning point in what the Russian military was.
sentences.zh: 所以那本应成为俄罗斯军队性质的一个真正转折点。

sentences.en: Because it'd become so obvious because this was their first international incursion since the collapse of the Soviet Union, right?
sentences.zh: 因为这一点变得显而易见，毕竟这是苏联解体后他们的首次国际军事行动，对吧？

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 绝对是。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And while Russia managed to win that war because of its sheer size advantage
sentences.zh: 虽然俄罗斯凭借其巨大的规模优势赢得了那场战争，

sentences.en: for Vladimir Putin, this was a serious issue because as Putin ratcheted up his aggressive foreign policy
sentences.zh: 但对于弗拉基米尔·普京来说，这是一个严重的问题，因为随着普京不断加强其激进的外交政策，

sentences.en: and his bid to remake Russia as a great power that has influence around the world and is respected around the world, a powerful military was really one of the key elements.
sentences.zh: 以及他试图重塑俄罗斯成为一个在全球拥有影响力并受人尊敬的大国，强大的军事力量确实是关键要素之一。

sentences.en: So it was Putin back then in 2008 who helped launch an effort to really reform the military, make it into a leaner and more effective and more lethal fighting machine.
sentences.zh: 因此，正是普京在2008年推动了一项旨在真正改革军队的努力，将其打造成一支更精简、更有效、更具杀伤力的战斗机器。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: So 2008 means that was eight years after Putin became president.
sentences.zh: 所以2008年意味着那是普京担任总统八年之后。

sentences.en: And this reform really was kind of something he wanted to push through.
sentences.zh: 而这项改革确实是他想要强力推行的事情。

sentences.en: What did he do?
sentences.zh: 他做了什么？

sentences.en: So the idea was among other things to kind of bring the Russian military into the digital age to move on
sentences.zh: 这个想法包括将俄罗斯军队带入数字时代，摆脱

sentences.en: from that increasingly obsolete Soviet era technology that the military was using, really taking a lot of
sentences.zh: 军队正在使用的那些日益过时的苏联时代技术，真正借鉴了

sentences.en: cues from that more nimble American military that Russian planners could see in action in Afghanistan and
sentences.zh: 当时俄罗斯规划者在阿富汗和

sentences.en: in Iraq around that time, improve communication systems, improve artillery systems, very importantly improve
sentences.zh: 伊拉克战场上所看到的更灵活的美国军队，改善通讯系统、炮兵系统，非常重要的一点是改善

sentences.en: the command structure to kind of try to make it a less top heavy military to give lower level officers more authority in the way they have in Western militaries.
sentences.zh: 指挥结构，试图建立一支不那么臃肿的军队，给予低级军官更多权力，就像西方军队那样。

sentences.en: So this was a huge undertaking and Putin put one guy in charge of it all.
sentences.zh: 所以这是一项巨大的工程，普京任命了一个人负责这一切。

sentences.en: His name is Anatoly Serdyukov, the defense minister at the time.
sentences.zh: 他的名字叫阿纳托利·谢尔久科夫，当时是国防部长。

sentences.en: Russia poured billions upon billions of dollars into this.
sentences.zh: 俄罗斯为此投入了数百亿计的美元。

sentences.en: In fact, Russia has been spending more than three percent of its entire economic output on defense compared to the fact that most European
sentences.zh: 事实上，俄罗斯在国防上的支出超过了其全部经济产出的百分之三，相比之下，大多数欧洲

sentences.en: countries have been struggling to spend two percent of GDP on defense.
sentences.zh: 国家一直在为将国防支出达到GDP的百分之二而挣扎。

sentences.en: And, you know, for much of the last decade, these reforms seem to be paying off.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，在过去十年的大部分时间里，这些改革似乎正在取得成效。

sentences.en: You turn on Russian TV and very frequently you see these dramatic missile launches showing off Russia's latest technology.
sentences.zh: 你打开俄罗斯电视，经常能看到那些展示俄罗斯最新技术的壮观导弹发射画面。

sentences.en: You see these huge military exercises that
sentences.zh: 你会看到那些俄罗斯定期举行的、

sentences.en: Russia does regularly with tens of thousands of troops seeming to show Russia's newfound military might and prowess.
sentences.zh: 动辄数万名士兵参与的庞大军事演习，似乎在展示俄罗斯新获得的军事力量和威望。

sentences.en: They take this kind of imagery so seriously that the Russian defense ministry even has its own television channel.
sentences.zh: 他们非常重视这种形象，以至于俄罗斯国防部甚至拥有自己的电视频道。

sentences.en: Okay, so there's this unbelievably glitzy display, right?
sentences.zh: 好的，所以有这种令人难以置信的华丽展示，对吧？

sentences.en: It's really projecting Russian power.
sentences.zh: 这确实是在投射俄罗斯的力量。

sentences.en: But what was going on underneath the surface?
sentences.zh: 但表面之下发生了什么？

sentences.en: Well, underneath the surface, we now realize these reforms were not really taking hold.
sentences.zh: 嗯，在表面之下，我们现在意识到这些改革并没有真正扎根。

sentences.en: For one thing, that Soviet-style top heavy command structure, as we look at the way the Ukraine war has been going, very clearly remains.
sentences.zh: 首先，正如我们观察乌克兰战争的进程所见，那种苏联式的臃肿指挥结构显然依然存在。

sentences.en: We're seeing so many examples, like the river crossing we talked about at the beginning of the show, that are showing that
sentences.zh: 我们看到了很多例子，比如我们在节目开头提到的渡河作战，都表明

sentences.en: officers on the ground have very limited authority in making decisions.
sentences.zh: 前线军官在决策方面权力非常有限。

sentences.en: And clearly a lot of these decisions are still being made at a very high level with limited flexibility on the ground that just
sentences.zh: 很明显，许多决策仍然是在非常高的层级做出的，前线缺乏灵活性，这

sentences.en: makes it so hard for units to react to rapidly changing conditions.
sentences.zh: 使得部队很难应对迅速变化的情况。

sentences.en: Because the guys who were ordinary soldiers can't troubleshoot.
sentences.zh: 因为普通士兵无法解决问题。

sentences.en: They can't do it on the fly.
sentences.zh: 他们无法临场应变。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And in this kind of fast-moving, modern battlefield, you need to have the people on the ground being able to make the decisions.
sentences.zh: 在这种快速变化的现代战场上，你需要让前线人员能够做出决策。

sentences.en: And then secondly, corruption.
sentences.zh: 其次是腐败。

sentences.en: That bane of post-Soviet Russia continues to plague the military.
sentences.zh: 这种后苏联时代俄罗斯的毒瘤继续困扰着军队。

sentences.en: Anton, why was the corruption such a problem?
sentences.zh: 安东，为什么腐败会成为如此严重的问题？

sentences.en: Well, it just meant that all this money that was supposed to go to modernizing the military went to line the pockets of generals and colonels.
sentences.zh: 嗯，这意味着所有本应用于军队现代化的资金都进了将军和上校们的腰包。

sentences.en: There have been so many cases reported in the Russian state news media of colonels and generals being charged with
sentences.zh: 俄罗斯国家新闻媒体报道了许多上校和将军被指控

sentences.en: fraud and embezzlement on the scale of 13 million dollars, 25 million dollars.
sentences.zh: 欺诈和挪用公款的案例，规模达到1300万美元、2500万美元。

sentences.en: Things like overstating the spending on contracts for satellites and other equipment and pocketing the difference.
sentences.zh: 比如夸大卫星和其他设备的合同支出，然后中饱私囊。

sentences.en: And of course, if that's what's being reported in the Russian state news media, what else is out there that isn't being reported publicly in Russia?
sentences.zh: 当然，如果这是俄罗斯国家新闻媒体所报道的内容，那么在俄罗斯还有什么是不公开报道的呢？

sentences.en: And that defense minister I talked about earlier, Anatoly Serdyukov, who was put in charge by Putin in 2008 to carry out those military reforMs. Well, he was fired a few
sentences.zh: 而我之前提到的那位国防部长阿纳托利·谢尔久科夫，他在2008年被普京任命负责执行那些军事改革。嗯，他在几年后

sentences.en: years later for being involved in a corruption scandal.
sentences.zh: 因为卷入腐败丑闻而被解职了。

sentences.en: So that corruption really pervades the military.
sentences.zh: 所以这种腐败确实渗透到了军队中。

sentences.en: In fact, our colleague Neil McFarquhar did a great story about this a few days ago, and he quotes a
sentences.zh: 事实上，我们的同事尼尔·麦克法夸尔几天前写了一篇很棒的报道，他引用了一位

sentences.en: Western official saying that in essence, in the Russian military, each person steals as much of the allocated funds as is appropriate for their rank.
sentences.zh: 西方官员的话说，本质上，在俄罗斯军队中，每个人都会窃取与其军衔相称的拨款资金。

sentences.en: So a colonel steals this much, a general steals more.
sentences.zh: 所以上校偷这么多，将军偷得更多。

sentences.en: It really does feel like corruption is so deeply ingrained in the Russian military, it's essentially part of how the system functions, still.
sentences.zh: 腐败确实感觉已经深深植根于俄罗斯军队，它本质上仍然是系统运作方式的一部分。

sentences.en: There's kind of a manual for it.
sentences.zh: 这就像有一本手册一样。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So even Putin, this all-powerful leader, who wants this reform really badly, can't get it because the corruption is just so entrenched.
sentences.zh: 所以即使是普京这位全能的领导人，他非常渴望改革，却无法实现，因为腐败已经根深蒂固。

sentences.en: And change just turned out to be impossible.
sentences.zh: 而改变结果证明是不可能的。

sentences.en: I mean, real change.
sentences.zh: 我是说，真正的改变。

sentences.en: So in the end, it was just the same old Russian army that it always had been.
sentences.zh: 所以最终，它还是那个一如既往的旧式俄罗斯军队。

sentences.en: But why then did we think it was so great?
sentences.zh: 但为什么我们当时认为它那么强大呢？

sentences.en: I mean, how did we see it the way we did just three months ago?
sentences.zh: 我是说，就在三个月前，我们是怎么看待它的？

sentences.en: Well, you know, it had recorded some successes that were very visible to the outside world.
sentences.zh: 嗯，你知道，它确实取得了一些外界非常明显的成功。

sentences.en: Think about the annexation of Crimea in 2014, where the Russian military managed to take control of that peninsula without firing a single shot.
sentences.zh: 想想2014年吞并克里米亚，俄罗斯军队在没有开一枪的情况下成功控制了那个半岛。

sentences.en: Think about the intervention in Syria in 2015, where Russia used this combination of precision-guided missile strikes, as well as brutal
sentences.zh: 想想2015年对叙利亚的干预，俄罗斯结合了精确制导导弹打击以及对叙利亚城市的残酷

sentences.en: bombardment of Syrian cities to change the tide of the Syrian civil war, to keep Putin's ally Assad in
sentences.zh: 轰炸，扭转了叙利亚内战的局势，让普京的盟友阿萨德继续

sentences.en: power, and to essentially give Russia a seat at the table in the geopolitics of the Middle EaSt.
sentences.zh: 掌权，并从本质上让俄罗斯在中东地缘政治中占有一席之地。

sentences.en: Those were all instances where it seemed like Russia's military had in fact been modernized to
sentences.zh: 所有这些例子似乎都表明俄罗斯军队确实已经现代化为

sentences.en: something more resembling a 21st century force and was successful in carrying out political objectives for the Kremlin.
sentences.zh: 某种更像21世纪的武装力量，并成功实现了克里姆林宫的政治目标。

sentences.en: But if you look more closely at those efforts, you see they were so different from what the Russian military is facing now.
sentences.zh: 但如果你仔细观察这些努力，你会发现它们与俄罗斯军队现在面临的情况截然不同。

sentences.en: And of course, Crimea was geographically a very limited and politically kind of a special case.
sentences.zh: 当然，克里米亚在地理上非常有限，在政治上也是一种特殊情况。

sentences.en: Syria, Russia was barely engaged on the ground, had dominance of the airspace, was facing very little of a fight back.
sentences.zh: 在叙利亚，俄罗斯几乎没有进行地面交战，拥有制空权，面临的反击也非常少。

sentences.en: So in a sense, those engagements showed us some limited improvements by the Russian military, but they were also kind of a mirage if you think about
sentences.zh: 所以从某种意义上说，这些交战向我们展示了俄罗斯军队的一些有限改进，但如果你考虑到

sentences.en: the type of military Russia clearly needed to make the current invasion of Ukraine work out.
sentences.zh: 俄罗斯显然需要那种类型的军队才能使当前的乌克兰入侵取得成功，那它们也算是一种海市蜃楼。

sentences.en: So what we've learned here is that the part of the Russian military that's modern
sentences.zh: 所以我们在这里了解到的是，俄罗斯军队中现代化的那一部分

sentences.en: is in fact very small, and that Russia's military is kind of the same as it always was, but also that the enemy itself has changed.
sentences.zh: 实际上非常小，俄罗斯军队和过去一样，但敌人本身也变了。

sentences.en: It's now all of Ukraine, and that military is bigger, it's better equipped, and it has all this help from the outside world.
sentences.zh: 现在面对的是整个乌克兰，那支军队规模更大、装备更好，并且得到了外界的所有帮助。

sentences.en: So it seems like that is actually making Russia's failure to modernize an even bigger problem for them now.
sentences.zh: 所以看起来这实际上让俄罗斯现代化失败的问题对他们来说变得更加严重了。

sentences.en: Yes, definitely.
sentences.zh: 是的，绝对是。

sentences.en: And also, as you say, the fact that the Russians clearly didn't count on Ukraine getting this much help from the West also worked to the Kremlin's detriment.
sentences.zh: 而且正如你所说，俄罗斯显然没有预料到乌克兰会从西方获得如此多的帮助，这也对克里姆林宫不利。

sentences.en: But I do want to add that Russia still has more cards to play.
sentences.zh: 但我确实想补充一点，俄罗斯还有牌可打。

sentences.en: It has huge resources still to draw on, both in terms of manpower and equipment.
sentences.zh: 它仍然拥有巨大的资源可以动用，无论是在人力还是装备方面。

sentences.en: So one of the things that Putin hasn't done, as we've talked about before on this show, is he still hasn't officially declared war.
sentences.zh: 所以普京还没有做的一件事，正如我们之前在节目中讨论过的，是他仍然没有正式宣战。

sentences.en: He hasn't instituted any kind of larger draft to put the military on a real wartime footing.
sentences.zh: 他没有进行任何形式的大规模征兵，将军队置于真正的战时状态。

sentences.en: He could still do that.
sentences.zh: 他仍然可以这样做。

sentences.en: And at that point, you know, if he's sending another 100,000 or more men into the fight, the fact that these military reforms didn't work out, potentially don't mean all that much.
sentences.zh: 到那时，你知道，如果他再派遣10万或更多士兵投入战斗，这些军事改革没有奏效的事实，可能就不那么重要了。

sentences.en: Russia could still find ways to overwhelm Ukraine and win this war.
sentences.zh: 俄罗斯仍然可以找到方法压倒乌克兰并赢得这场战争。

sentences.en: Even though Russia is struggling now, we're not seeing any indications that the Russians are ready to fold here and go home.
sentences.zh: 尽管俄罗斯现在陷入困境，但我们没有看到任何迹象表明俄罗斯准备在这里认输回家。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Just because Russia's military isn't that modern doesn't mean it's going to lose.
sentences.zh: 仅仅因为俄罗斯军队没那么现代化，并不意味着它会输。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Anton, thank you.
sentences.zh: 安东，谢谢你。

sentences.en: Thank you, Sabrina.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，萨布丽娜。

sentences.en: of potential recruits to its military by eliminating the age limit for service.
sentences.zh: 其军队的潜在征兵范围。

sentences.en: The change would allow
sentences.zh: 这一改变将允许

sentences.en: Russian President Vladimir Putin to shore up the numbers of fighting forces without ordering a large scale draft.
sentences.zh: 俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京在不进行大规模征兵的情况下增加战斗部队的人数。

sentences.en: Under the current law, Russian citizens must be aged 18 to 40 to sign a first time contract.
sentences.zh: 根据现行法律，俄罗斯公民必须在18至40岁之间才能签署首次合同。

sentences.en: The change would allow Russians older than 40 to sign contracts.
sentences.zh: 这一改变将允许40岁以上的俄罗斯人签署合同。

sentences.en: On Sunday, President Biden arrived in Tokyo to begin the second leg of his diplomatic tour in Asia.
sentences.zh: 周日，拜登总统抵达东京，开始他亚洲外交之旅的第二站。

sentences.en: The president will announce a new alliance focused on strengthening economic ties between the U.S.
sentences.zh: 总统将宣布一项新的联盟，旨在加强美国

sentences.en: The administration's plan, called the Indo-Pacific Economic Framework, will set standards for the digital economy, clean energy, and the global supply chain.

sentences.en: It is also aimed at countering the influence of China in the region.
